create_janus_model: create a Janus model for multimodal image-text understanding and generation
run_conditional_generation: run conditional text generation with JanusForConditionalGeneration given image and text inputs
generate_image_tokens: generate image tokens autoregressively using JanusForConditionalGeneration with CFG-guided sampling
decode_image_tokens: decode generated image tokens back to pixel values using JanusVQVAE decoder
build_vision_encoder: build a Siglip-based vision encoder with JanusVisionModel for image feature extraction
